name: SPX Rundown Item
description: Structure documentation for an SPX-GC rundown item object

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the rundown item

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name shown in the SPX-GC UI rundown list

fields.name: template
fields.description: Path to the HTML template file relative to TEMPLATES folder

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current playback state: idle, playing, or stopped

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Array of field name/value pairs populating the template

fields.name: field
fields.description: Template variable name (e.g., f0, title, subtitle)

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value to render in the template variable

fields.name: out
fields.description: Render output target (CasparCG, OBS, vMix, etc.)

fields.name: playDelay
fields.description: Delay in milliseconds before automatic playback
